Prior team-handling experience will be an added advantage. Language Requirement Mandatory: English — Excellent Hindi — Fluent Marathi — Fluent The candidate should be comfortable conducting customer conversations, negotiations, presentations, and follow-ups in all three languages. Ensure transparent communication with stakeholders and investors where required.

Ensure compliance with: Investor grievance redressal timelines Digital communication and disclosures Data privacy, cybersecurity, and access controls Maintain SOPs, service documentation, and auditready records. Support internal audits, regulatory inspections, and RTA reviews. 
 6. Performance Monitoring & Reporting 
 Track and analyze key digital service and investor experience metrics: Digital service volumes vs assisted Complaint ratios and resolution trends Turnaround times and SLA adherence Channelwise adoption and usage Publish MIS dashboards and insights for senior management.
